scope: All combat equipment rewards in the warbond dictionary
notes: Korean display terminology and factual stat values come from the Korean equipment reference sections. Effect prose is a concise factual summary, not a claim to reproduce every in-game sentence verbatim.
Weapon stat panels and actual damage calculations are distinct; charged plasma damage is explicitly identified as direct plus explosion. Stratagem timings exclude ship module upgrades.

Namu uses CQC-72 for the purchasable Entrenchment Tool and AX/ARC-9 in the K-9 heading. Preserve the catalog IDs and canonical CQC-73 / AX/ARC-3 names; official Korean Entrenched Division introduction confirms CQC-73.
Gas Mortar statistics cross-checked with Wiki.gg. CQC-9 has verified effects but no unverified numeric values are supplied.

combatReview.basis: Namu Wiki mirrored projectile/damage tables; live HTML fetched with the system CA trust store.
combatReview.display: Frontal penetration; explosion center/outer/shockwave values are separate. Demolition uses the stated base force, not an assertion that every structure can be destroyed.
combatReview.unknown: Missing source values remain null and display as unconfirmed. Utility-only shields/flight packs have no combat table.
